bibl.title: The Invention of Stesichorus: Hesiod, Helen, and the Muse.
bibl.seg: Jesús Carruesco, The Invention of Stesichorus: Hesiod, Helen, and the Muse.

Egbert J. Bakker (ed.), Authorship and Greek Song: Authority, Authenticity, and Performance = Studies in Archaic and Classical Greek Song. 3 = Mnemosyne. Supplements. 402 (Leiden - Boston, 2017) pp. 178-196.
bibl.note: Explores the definition of Stesichorus' persona as representative of a specific kind of poetry and focuses in particular on the relationship of the poet with Helen in the Palinode, where this self-definition was carried out.
